img_lead: The project's own image: the Dockerfile in .jgates/image/ adds your tools to the JGates tools image. It is built only when you ask, never during a validation.
img_status_text_ready: The image was built for this Dockerfile and for the current tools image.
img_status_text_outdated: The image has to be rebuilt.
img_status_text_unknown: The image could not be checked: the container engine or the JGates tools image is not available. See Environment.
img_status_text_none: This project has no .jgates/image/Dockerfile, so there is nothing to build.
img_cause_never-built: Outdated because it has not been built on this computer yet.
img_cause_files-changed: Outdated because the Dockerfile, or a file of the .jgates/image/ folder, changed since the last build.
img_cause_base-changed: Outdated because the JGates tools image changed (a JGates update) since the last build.
img_rebuild_note: The build uses the network (the install lines of the Dockerfile) and may take a few minutes. It is the same as jgates tools build-extension.
img_current: The image {tag} was already built for this Dockerfile; it was built again.
img_file_label: Content of the extension image Dockerfile
img_file_truncated: The file is larger than the limit shown here; the end is not displayed.
